name: 片场
description: 片场：一件要创意的活（宣传片、宣传稿、海报、文案），让群里几个不同模型的 Agent 同时各出几张卡，群里的人批注、选卡、打回（也可以叫哪个 Agent 来看看，它用同一个批注），选中的卡进下一轮混搭，直到成片。拍真产品的片子照 promo-video skill 做。

en.name: Studio
en.description: Studio: a creative job (a promo film, an article, a poster, copy) where several agents of different models in the group each hand in cards; people annotate, pick or send cards back, and the picks are mixed in the next round until the film is done.

author: promo-skills
